author: petr1petr
body:
yes, you cast spell (skill) and heretic jewel may apply T.Res down. Spore may apply poison, sleep and blight. etc.

further - enchant on weapon may proc as well - so having water enchant on weapon and casting multi flame may result in target getting frozen. Thats why spellcasters (unlike melee classes) love to have enchanted weapons. no downside, only bonus

author: permaculturegeek
body: They can proc if you use any offensive move but not if you buff, use a potion etc. As Beo, I think they follow through to pet attacks, since I still see them appear if I'm redlining in endless and just using mana potion each turn.

author: MeijiHKitty
body: They are passives that can apply while using skills/spells

author: Widogeist
body: For some clarification, adornments that cause debuffs on the enemy, whether it's stat debuffs (like your heretic jewel for t.res --) or status debuffs (burn, blight, freeze, poison, stasis, petrification, etc), only trigger on the enemy if you are using a damaging spell/ability against the enemy. Using buffs or debuffs on enemies won't trigger the adornment debuffs, you need to use a damaging spell/ability to trigger it. The same goes for debuffs associated with weapon enchantments, you need to use a damaging ability for a chance to trigger it.
